fusions.name: Unseen First Cut
fusions.desc: A snap that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Flank Opened
fusions.desc: A slash from the side that deals 30 damage, is always a critical hit, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Teeth Bared Late
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting Edge
fusions.desc: When you go a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
